title: The Kobold Envoy
text: A kobold in a crown too big for him, the rim resting on his snout, struts up the road with a scroll. He speaks for the dragon of these hills, he squeaks, and the dragon wants tribute. Very high above him, a shadow passes over the sun.

options.label: Pay the dragon's tribute and keep that shadow in the sky.

outcomes.text: The kobold bows so low his crown falls off. The hills are quiet for you after that.

options.label: The shrewdest claims the House has already paid, hoping the kobold cannot count.

outcomes.text: He checks his list, confused, and waves you on.

options.label: Seize the kobold and his crown, and see what the dragon does about it.

outcomes.text: The crown is only gilt. His kin come swarming out of the rocks, shrieking.
